context_requirements: Expression of at least one PPAR subtype (PPARA, PPARD, or PPARG)
Presence of RXR heterodimer partner and functional PPRE-driven transcription
For PPARG-mediated effects, sufficient PPARG expression or ligand-dependent activation
For PPARA-mediated effects, high fatty acid oxidation capacity (e.g., hepatocyte-like cells)
For PPARD-mediated effects, active fatty acid metabolism and/or Wnt signaling context
falsifiers: No significant change in any of the proximal_up or proximal_down genes at 6 h or 24 h in any cell line
Strong and consistent upregulation of inflammatory genes (e.g., IL1B, CXCL2, PTGS2) across lines, opposite to expected anti-inflammatory PPAR effects
No difference in response between PPAR-expressing and PPAR-negative lines
Predominant upregulation of cell-cycle genes rather than the expected growth arrest and proliferation_down signature

changes: Removed MMP2 from proximal_down because PPAR agonists generally do not acutely repress MMP2 transcription; its regulation is indirect and late.
Removed CDKN1A from late_down because PPAR agonists typically induce CDKN1A (p21) to promote growth arrest, not repress it.
Removed MMP1 from late_down because it is already listed in proximal_down and a gene must not appear in both an up and a down list of the same time.
Removed MMP2 from late_down because it is not a validated direct PPAR-repressed gene and its inclusion is redundant with the proximal list.
Removed cholesterol_synthesis_up from generic_effects because PPAR activation does not consistently increase cholesterol synthesis and may decrease it via LXR crosstalk.
Changed line_response for A549 from moderate to weak because A549 has low PPARG expression and is relatively resistant to PPAR agonist effects.
Changed line_response for MCF7 from moderate to weak because MCF7 has low PPARG and PPARA expression and is less responsive to PPAR agonists.
Changed line_response for HT29 from moderate to weak because HT29 has low PPARD expression and is less responsive to PPAR agonists.
Changed line_response for PC3 from weak to moderate because PC3 expresses PPARG and responds to PPARγ agonists.
Changed line_response for VCAP from weak to moderate because VCAP expresses PPARG and responds to PPARγ agonists.
